references.text: Describes Israel's victory over Sihon and the conquest of the land from Arnon, which is the same area mentioned in Deuteronomy 3:12
Moses gave the land to the tribe of Gad, the tribe of Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, including the Gilead region
Mentions Aroer by the Arnon Valley as the starting point for Israel's conquest, the same geographical reference as in this verse
Describes the same territory from Aroer by the Arnon Valley, confirming the boundaries of the conquered land
Sihon's kingdom extended from Aroer by the Arnon Valley, the same area that was given to Reuben and Gad
Joshua confirms the distribution of the land east of the Jordan to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, including Gilead
Detailed description of Reuben's inheritance from Aroer by the Arnon, which corresponds with Moses' allocation
Describes Gad's inheritance in the Gilead region, which Moses had assigned to them
